name: middleleap-npa-uae
description: New Product Approval for a CBUAE-regulated bank — the Business Proposition Form with every field, the CBUAE anchor behind each, sign-off routing and BAU assessments, and how the Loom assembles the pack in discovery and turns it into the PA1/PA2 receipts. Applies to any customer-facing product change (Open Finance, lending, cards, pricing, channels, withdrawals); worked examples use the fictional Meridian Trust.
